ChangeLog: V7.6 Changelog -> Added new "Shop" page and moved Auto Buy Beans section to it. -> Added Auto Buy Moves in Shop page. -> Added Auto Collect Components in Auto page, Dungeons section. -> Added Kill All Enemies setting for Auto Dungeon in Dungeons section to complement the new Auto Collect Components feature. -> Added Auto Rejoin in Misc page. -> Added Loop Fling in Main page, it is powerful and can ruin servers without having to do anything so if it gets abused too much ill remove it. -> Added Tag Spoof in Main page. -> Added Smooth Lock Strength slider. -> Added a Targeted Combat section in Main page. -> Added Guard Breaker in Targeted Combat. -> Added On Hit in Targeted Combat. -> Added "Combat Target" option to Targeting Mode dropdowns in Moves Aimbot and TP Behind Moves. -> Added Silent Namekian Regeneration in Misc page, removes the Regeneration animation and lets you move freely while using it, only thing is that the sound will still play. -> Added Capsule Spoof in the Misc page (this is intended to make Grounded Capsule NOT prevent you from flying, I have not tested it because I do not have that capsule. If it's still not possible to fly and you have an account with the capsule and would let me test then dm me). -> Added Notifications toggle in Settings page so you can disable notifications sent by features if you want to. -> Added optional Delay slider to Anti Knockback. -> Added value suffixes like "%" and " s" to sliders where it makes sense so many sliders are easier to read. -> Added Particles option in the Map Objects performance dropdown. -> Improved Anti Legit Miss, no longer slows you down when running even if hit was cancelled and is now supported in all execs. -> Improved FPS Cap config behavior so default values do not force unwanted FPS changes. -> Improved layout of some sections in the Main and Visuals page. -> Reworked G/H Form Override dropdowns into a single "No Form Charge" toggle that simply makes you able to use any form without having to charge without forcing you into only being able to transform into that form like it happened with the old system, also allowing you to use stuff like Namekian's Regeneration ability which wasn't possible before due to the force transform. I think that it does work in bad execs like Xeno, if it doesn't tell me. -> TeleSpeed now also boosts vertical movement. -> Admin Auto Leave is now a dropdown in its own section with "Server Hop" (old behavior), "Kick", "Disable Features" and "UnHook" options, also added an optional Testers setting toggle that will make you perform the selected action if a tester joins or is in your server. -> Invasion Protection Will now disable all autos such as Auto Quest when taking you back to Namek to avoid interruptions when traveling to the ship. -> Auto Healing Chamber feature is now always visible, not only when in a dungeon. -> Replaced all the event toggles in the Webhooks section with a single multi dropdown. -> Bypassed a specific FSR check that detected Xeno, so Xeno can now do some stuff better. -> Made anything that talks to NPCs much safer in general. -> Removed Anti AFK toggle to prevent UI clutter, Anti AFK is now built in and gets disabled when script closes. -> Moved Anti Legit Miss to Targeted Combat. -> Auto Quest no longer travels to the Red Ribbon Giver quest NPC if you have already done the first quest. -> Now you stop flying in the NamekEggGiver quest to avoid failing it if you were flying. -> Script doesn't break game prompts anymore after interacting with one of them if your exec supports getcallbackvalue. -> Fixed dying clearing all your selected moves in the Moves dropdowns except one (e.g: you had Meteor Crash and Wolf Fang Fist selected, then you die and only Meteor Crash was selected). -> Fixed No Slow not getting disabled when turning off the toggle due to a dumb mistake from my part (variable typo). -> Fixed Auto Escape Reset mode resetting you in quests where you can't die, it will use Regen mode instead. -> Fixed Auto Healing Chamber using multiple healing chambers in a single healing round. -> Fixed Auto Dungeon having a probability of breaking and stopping completely, which was much more common with Kill All Enemies enabled hence why i discovered it and it was pretty rare with it disabled. -> Fixed Auto Dungeon not automatically claiming the Loot Safe of the RR dungeon due to a in game change. -> Fixed Acrylic Blur breaking some auto aim attacks like Final Blow and some other bugs. -> Fixed incorrect run keybind that some features use for controller. -> Fixed some small memory leaks. -> Fixed some noticeable errors with Fling. -> Fixed ESP on namek dragon balls not disappearing after picking them up. -> Fixed Auto Transform not getting disabled in the Yamu and Spopovich quest which you can't transform. -> Fixed duplicated transformations in Auto Transform Form dropdown. -> Other minor improvements, fixes and cleanup.
